# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster receives basic idea of item’s purpose, if any.
@@ 2
Detects power in an object, but not what realm or how much; caster may
concentrate on a different object each round.
@@ 3
Gives a general idea of the place of origin of an item.
@@ 5
Detects if a curse is on an item.
@@ 6
Gives the origins of an item’s power.
@@ 7
Gives details of where, when, and how the examined piece of rock was worked.
@@ 8
Gives a vision of a significant event in the item’s past.
@@ 10
Gives significant details about an item’s construction and purpose (not
specific powers).
@@ 11
Caster gets a vision up to 1 hour per level into the past. The desired time
can be set within ±30 min. The vision must be associated with an item or
place. The vision can last up to 1 minute per level if the caster concentrates
and remains inactive.
@@ 13
Gives major abilities and powers of an item.
@@ 15
Gives a vision of how someone died and an image of their killer. This spell
must be cast within 24 hours of the death. In addition, this spell must be
cast at the place of death or in the presence of the dead body.
@@ 17
When cast just before a Past Vision spell, it allows caster to lock onto a
specific event in an item’s past, and then examine that event with a Past
Vision.
@@ 19
Gives a complete rundown on an item’s construction, powers, and purpose (may
be modified if an item is extremely powerful).
@@ 20
As Past Vision I, except time range is 1 day per level (with an error of ±1
hour) and the vision can last up to 10 minutes per level.
@@ 25
As Past Vision I, except time range is 1 month per level (with an error of ±1
day) and the vision can last up to 1 hour per level.
@@ 30
As Past Vision I, except time range is 1 year per level (with an error of ±1
week) and the vision can last up to 5 hours per level.
@@ 50
As Past Vision I, except time range is 10 year per level (with an error of ±1
month) and vision can last up to 10 hours per level (each hour of the past
event takes only 10 minutes real time).
